ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are concentrated in water spray and specular glare along the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark region with no distinct high-contrast geometric white blobs or mottling visible on the integument itself; scattered white pixels on the right lobe appear to be water droplets rather than pigment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 125 degrees at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregularities; the left lobe trailing edge contains at least three deep, rectangular-shaped missing sections (notches); the right lobe edge is highly serrated with frequent peaks leading to an irregular tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical; the left lobe follows a convex curve to a tapered point; the right lobe sweep is interrupted by a blunt, irregular distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss and deep notches along the trailing edge of the left lobe; a large, irregular, jagged protrusion at the tip of the right lobe indicating possible trauma or pathological growth.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique, bulbous and highly irregular structural deformity at the distal end of the right lobe.
